review.assessment: The diff creates solution.py with an increment method that performs a non-atomic read-modify-write cycle without any synchronization primitives like a lock. By inserting time.sleep(0) between the read and write steps, it explicitly yields execution to other threads, guaranteeing interleaved updates rather than preventing them. This change fails to satisfy the concurrency requirement and will consistently produce incorrect counts under parallel access.

findings.actual: A number less than 1000 (typically 950-980 depending on scheduling), because multiple threads overwrite each other's calculations during the yielded gap.
